title: Cannabis 101: Beginner Guides to Weed
metaDescription: Cannabis 101 from High Society: beginner guides to THC and CBD, flower, vapes, edibles and concentrates, label basics and the start-low, go-slow rule.

hero.lead: New to cannabis, or coming back after a long break? Cannabis 101 covers the basics in plain language: what THC and CBD are, how flower, vapes, edibles and concentrates differ, how each one is used and how to read the figures on a product label. Trying a new product? Keep the first serving small and be patient. When you visit, our budtenders are happy to help you find a good fit.
